text:
Alex (People Ops): hey managers — dropping a tiny pack of self-review quickcards you can paste into 1:1s, Slack threads, or review forms. each is 1–2 short prompts + an example. tweak as needed.

Alex (People Ops): QUICKCARD: Impact summary
- Prompt: In 2 bullets, what top outcomes did you own this cycle? include numbers if you can.
- Example: Reduced average inference latency from 220ms → 140ms; p95 improved 35%.

Alex (People Ops): QUICKCARD: Challenge + Learn
- Prompt: One sentence on a big challenge + one sentence on what you learned.
- Example: Scaling the batcher exposed a race; implemented idempotent retries and learned to add request dedupe at the gateway.

Alex (People Ops): QUICKCARD: Stretch goal status
- Prompt: State met/partial/not met + 1 reason.
- Example: Partial — model rollout delayed by infra capacity; mitigations landed but full traffic not yet shifted.

Alex (People Ops): QUICKCARD: Collaboration highlight
- Prompt: Name a partner and the result you shipped together.
- Example: With infra, shipped autoscaler that cut serving costs 18%.

Alex (People Ops): QUICKCARD: Manager ask
- Prompt: One thing your manager can do next cycle to help your impact.
- Example: Help unblock hiring for a senior infra engineer to finish the autoscaler polish.

Alex (People Ops): GOAL PHRASE TEMPLATES (1-liners)
- Objective: Make inference predictable at scale.
- KR1: p95 latency under 200ms for 95% of requests by end of Q.
- KR2: Reduce per-token cost by 15% via batching/quantization.

Alex (People Ops): MANAGER FEEDBACK STARTERS (short)
- "You shipped X quickly and that unlocked Y; next I want you to focus on Z."
- "Consider pairing with A to accelerate adoption of your change."
- "Great ownership on infra — push more on cross-team docs so others can reuse it."

Priya (Eng Manager): Love these. can we add a short IC-career quickcard? something about growth signals not just output.

Alex (People Ops): good call — adding CAREER SNAPSHOT quickcard:
- Prompt: Name 1 skill you grew, 1 area to develop, and 1 request you'd like from the org.
- Example: Grew infra-systems debugging; needs experience owning end-to-end release; request: pairing with a senior release lead.

Jamal (PM): can we get a PM-flavored line for product folks? e.g., how to show prioritization tradeoffs + outcomes in 2 lines.

Alex (People Ops): sure — PM QUICKCARD:
- Prompt: Describe the decision you made, the tradeoffs, and the outcome metric. 1 sentence.
- Example: Prioritized model A over B to preserve latency; accepted 2% lower accuracy; resulted in 12% higher retention due to faster responses.

Mei (People Ops): pinned in #ops-templates and added a Notion page with copy/paste cards + a tiny checklist for managers to run the self-review sync: "send reminder, 48h buffer, 30min review meeting, share 3 takeaways." link: https://notion.redwoodinference/workspace/self-review-quickcards (internal)

Priya (Eng Manager): thanks! i'll paste a few into my reminder thread now. :thumbsup:

Jamal (PM): these will help our folks be less wordy. can you add a tiny example for "cross-team impact"?

Alex (People Ops): added one-liner for cross-team impact: "Coordinated with infra & product analytics to launch autoscaler; reduced cost 18% and enabled 2x traffic without regressions."

Mei (People Ops): quick note — if you want manager-ready email text, reply and i'll drop a 2-paragraph template you can send to directs.

Priya (Eng Manager): will do, thanks team.

Alex (People Ops): cheers — ping us for role-specific variants (infra, ml, growth). happy to iterate.
